nodes.question: Who are the target audiences for the manuscript discussing net-zero agriculture in Africa?
nodes.answer: The target audiences include policymakers, government officials, researchers, academics, agricultural and environmental organizations, private sectors, agribusiness leaders, development agencies, financial institutions, agricultural cooperatives, and young professionals.

nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: Why are supermarkets identified as a promising place to shift consumer choices?
nodes.answer: Supermarkets are identified as promising because they are where most consumers in Western societies buy their groceries, thus reaching a wide range of individuals effectively.
